parsed.rationale: Regular sinus rhythm with narrow QRS, normal R-wave progression (R waves already in V3), no pathological Q waves, and no significant ST elevation or reciprocal changes, so I don't see evidence of anterior MI; the V2-V3 ST/T appearance with upright T waves is consistent with a normal variant.
